correctness.rationale: The Lee weight on F5 respects column sign reversal. Each generator column of F5^2 therefore has exactly 13 sign-orbit types including zero, so the exact number of spanning rank-two normalized multisets at length n is binomial(n+12,12)-6*binomial(n+2,2)+5. Its n=2..6 values are 60,400,1735,6067,18401. An independently written full C++17 census enumerated every such multiset, evaluated each of 25 primal combinations and the full dual Lee enumerator using the exact character factors F0=1+2z+2z², F1=1+αz+(-1-α)z², F2=1+(-1-α)z+αz², α²=1-α. Each primal spectrum uniquely determined its dual for n<=6, across 1,5,18,49,129 primal spectrum signatures respectively, with all irrational components canceled and integer divisibility checked. A separate direct 5^7-vector dual enumeration (not using Fourier) confirmed equal primal Lee spectra for the two 7-column generators and distinct dual Lee-weight-4 counts 56 and 60. This is an exact finite exhaustive proof within fixed dimension two; it does not extrapolate to other dimensions.
